lines.en: \c[1]Jebediah's library and laboratory\c[0]
lines.zh: \c[1]耶比底亚的图书馆和实验室\c[0]

lines.en: S-Stop!!  How did you get here?!  This is highly forbidden!!
lines.zh: 停、停下！！ 你是怎么进来的？！ 这是高度禁止的！！

lines.en: Is that so?  I must have gotten lost.  What's a girl to do...
lines.zh: 是这样吗？ 我肯定是迷路了。\人家该怎么办呢……
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: Your father will hear of this!  Y-you cannot be in here!!
lines.zh: 你父亲会知道这一切的！ 你、你不能来这里！！

lines.en: Shut your mouth and do what you're told.
lines.zh: 闭上你的嘴然后乖乖按我说的做。
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: W...what?  I don't have to listen to you!!
lines.zh: 什……什么？ 我根本不用听你的！

lines.en: You do, and you will!
lines.zh: 你当然得听，而且你会听的！
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: B-but... but...
lines.zh: 可、可是……可是……

lines.en: Hahahaha...  look at you now.  You human males are all alike.  With little effort, you're putty in my hands.  ...Aren't you, my little minion?
lines.zh: 哈哈哈哈哈哈…… 瞧你现在这熊样。 你们人类男人都一个德行。 不费吹灰之力，就被我任意拿捏 ……你说是不是呀，我的小跟班？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: What are you doing here, Beatrix?  I wish you would leave...
lines.zh: 你在这里做什么，碧翠丝？ 求求了你快走吧……

lines.en: Oh, you love this, almost as much as I do.  I'm just indulging my curiosity. Here you are, all cooped up, studying all this prophecy nonsense.  I'd very much like to see your work!
lines.zh: 噢，你喜欢这场对话，都快要赶上我了 。我只是在满足我的好奇心。瞧瞧你，关在这个鸡笼般的地方，折腾这些天书似的预言。 我倒是挺想看看你的成果呢！
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: ....  N-no, I...  no one can see this!  You won't even understand it! You'll ruin everything with your clumsy recklessness!
lines.zh: …… 不、不，我…… 没人准许看这个！ 你甚至连一个标点符号也不会懂！你的粗枝大叶会把一切都毁了！

lines.en: Are you questioning my intellect?!
lines.zh: 你是在怀疑我的智力吗？！
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: Wait just a minute...  you're trying to provoke me now.  Well, if it's gonna be that way, I'm leaving right now if you don't show me everything. Hmph!
lines.zh: 等一下啊…… 你这是在试图激将我哎。 嗳，要是真这样的话，你不给我看，我现在就走。哼！
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: No! Wait!  Please, have a look around...
lines.zh: 别！等等！ 请，请随便看吧……

lines.en: There you go!  What are those scrolls there, hmm?
lines.zh: 这就对了嘛！ 那些卷轴都是些什么，嗯？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: This is my transcription of the Historium Magnus...  But it is a very delicate project, please, I beg you, do not interrupt it, or the translation will be ruined...
lines.zh: 这是我默写的《伟大史书》…… 但这个东西真的很复杂，拜托了，求你，别弄乱了，乱了翻译就全毁了……

lines.en: By Donar, you're doing this from memory? Always the consummate bookworm!  Hmm, what's this map all about?
lines.zh: 多纳尔在上，你是全凭记忆在做这个的？真是个极致的书呆子！ 嗯……这地图又是关于什么的？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: That transcription is complete...  it is the locations of all five of the Nephilim shrines.  If I were to retrieve the Historium Magnus again, the secrets within would...
lines.zh: 它的默写已经做好了…… 它记载着全部五个圣灵神殿的位置。 如果我能把《伟大史书》拿回来的话，里边的秘密就能……

lines.en: ...No kidding?  Well, well... very good work here, Jebby.  Good boys get rewarded, you know.
lines.zh: ……真的吗？ 哎呀哎呀……你做得非常好，耶比。 好孩子是会得到奖励的，你知道吧？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: ...  Rewarded?
lines.zh: …… 奖励？

lines.en: Mmhmm, that's right.  Why don't you just look the other way while I study this map for myself.  You wouldn't want to disappoint Beatrix would you?
lines.zh: 嗯哼……没错。 为什么你不在我研究这地图的时候往别处瞅瞅？ 你不会想要打扰碧翠丝吧？
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: N-no, of course not...
lines.zh: 不、不，当然不……

lines.en: You behave yourself while I'm away, my little Jeb.  Farewell, until we meet again!
lines.zh: 我不在的时候你要好好表现哦，我的小耶比。 再见啦，后会有期！
lines.name: 贝雅特丽
